about:
Restaurant Equipment Company, known as RECO, operates from Festus, Missouri, along U.S. Route 67. The business is family-owned and operated, though the founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed. It began as a supplier of commercial kitchen equipment to the regional food-service market.

The company stocks and sells new commercial restaurant equipment sourced from several well-known manufacturers, covering categories such as cooking, refrigeration, preparation, and warewashing. In addition to distribution, RECO fabricates custom cutting boards to customer-specified dimensions, offering a made-to-order service for food-preparation surfaces.

Customers include independent restaurants and food-service operators throughout the Midwest and beyond. The firm’s partnerships with established equipment brands allow it to outfit full commercial kitchens or supply replacement units for existing operations.

RECO emphasizes affordable pricing, durability, and reliability across its product lines, framing its mission around meeting vital equipment needs while maintaining high quality standards. The ownership cites long-standing manufacturer relationships as a cornerstone of its ability to deliver consistent value.
